name: Dot-com valuation and commercial exceptionalism
description: Speculative promotion of internet businesses through audience metrics and transformational commercial claims.
cause_of_death: The dot-com collapse undermined exceptionalist valuation claims; contemporaneous satire and later empirical critiques challenged the rhetoric.
